rules: Relations change because of events/actions, not passive elapsed time alone unless an existing timed agreement/condition explicitly expires.
First Contact does not automatically mature into normal relations, trade, treaty, alliance or Federation membership.
Trust/tension summaries cannot override treaty/access/recognition facts.
High tension may become hostile but cannot create war without an explicit Block 3 cause/action.
Relations remain scoped to the actual recognized polity/institution.
A partial-polity relation cannot bind a whole divided planet.
Government succession may require recognition review rather than silently copying all diplomatic authority.
Public opinion and government diplomatic state remain separate.
